meta.title: 이음 만년필
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (이음 만년필, a fountain pen whose line never breaks (fictional brand)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 이음 만년필, a fountain pen whose line never breaks (fictional brand)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Two colours only: deep navy paper #13203A darkening to #0D1729 at the edges, and one gold line #E3B657 with a soft glow; a pale gold #F6DA94 for the glint that runs along it at the end, cream #F2E8D2 for type.
rationale.type: Nanum Myeongjo ExtraBold for the name and the line, a calligraphic serif that suits ink; Gowun Batang for the small labels.
rationale.motion: One line drawn over the whole reel: the pen slows at every turn (corners cost more time than straights), the camera rides a little behind the nib so the line leads the eye, and the reveal pulls far back to show that everything was one picture; a glint then runs along the finished line.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 80 BPM in E major on recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): a soft pad, a softly played upright piano for the motion, a cello hook, a sine sub, a soft kick and shaker; a pen-on-paper whisper (pen) under every stretch of drawing, a chime as the heart closes.
rationale.visuals: All code: the drawing is one polyline in world coordinates built from parametric parts (a nib, a trochoid of loops, a cup, an open notebook with zigzag writing, a plant, a sweep and a heart) joined by cubic connectors that keep the direction; it is drawn to a cost along its length, through a camera given by the mean of points behind the tip.
